scope: Version-history screening of all 16 additions in the 2026-10-14 manifest tail (15 arXiv plus MorphoPlanner), all 15 records in the prior-version-checks file, ten additional arXiv core papers, and six selected tactile/benchmark papers. Total 46 distinct arXiv histories and one Preprints.org version page.
coverage_limits: Not an exhaustive historical-corpus, journal, conference, or project-code review. Non-arXiv core records TouchWGNN, RoboPack and VTDexManip were not version-screened.
Authoritative publisher/arXiv pages were retrieved through web tooling; several results were cached up to three days before this check. Negative findings refer to the retrieved histories.
Only ForeTac and ILA received fresh exact-version PDF comparison. Other records received metadata/version-history checks only.
No experiments were replicated or software executed. Unchanged reported values do not establish that experiments were rerun after a methods-description revision.
ILA normalized extracted text is identical after removal of version watermark and repeated venue header; every raster/vector object was not compared, so exact figure-pixel equivalence is not claimed.
conclusion: One strict post-2026-10-14 revision found: ForeTac v2, 2026-10-20 10:22:41 UTC. ILA v2, 2026-10-14 16:29:07 UTC, is a same-day boundary update relative to the manifest's v1 pin. No other post-October-14 revision was present in the checked histories.

revision_audits.summary: ForeTac v2 changes the contact-quality model, not the reported performance: four contact classes and a good-minus-logsumexp-failures objective in v1 become two good/bad prototypes, binary cross-entropy, and a good-minus-bad logit margin. The scorer dataset is now described as 100 good and 120 bad episodes; seed 42 is no longer stated. The direct-current-contact control is clarified as using the same good/bad labels and guidance schedule. Tables I–VI, task success/contact success values, action-masking and prefix diagnostics, and reported latency remain unchanged. Causal tactile history, candidate-action-conditioned prediction, frozen policy checkpoints, and inference-time gradient guidance still support structured predictive-contact evidence, not a hand–tool–object graph or topology transfer. Auxiliary tactile pretraining, task-specific outcome supervision, 20 trials per task, absent repeated-seed uncertainty, and additional replanning cost still constrain interpretation. Treat this as a substantive correction to the documented method, not proof of newly rerun experiments or stronger generalization.
evidence_locators: v1 p.3 end/p.4 III-D.1 equations 10-11: four classes and log-sum-exp over failure classes.
v2 p.4 III-D.1 equations 10-11: two good/bad prototypes and direct logit difference.
v1 p.5 IV-A.5: 100 desired-contact + 40 for each of three failures, four-class cross-entropy, seed 42.
v2 p.5 IV-A.5: 100 good + 120 bad, outcome-balanced sampling; seed 42 statement absent.
v2 p.6 IV-C: direct-current-contact control now explicitly has same good/bad labels and guidance schedule.
v1 and v2 Tables I-VI: same tabulated performance, representation, action-mask, prefix and ranking values.
v2 p.7 IV-F: 261.26 +/- 5.16 ms versus 132.46 +/- 1.39 ms; unchanged numerical runtime.
